note: Seed prices in USD per million tokens (short-context tier). Verify against the provider's pricing page; override with the suite's `pricing` field or `--prices <file>`. Models not listed have unknown cost (reported as null), never a guess. For OpenAI models the single cache-write rate is stored in `cacheWrite5mPerMTok`. Long-context tiers (higher per-token prices above a context-size threshold) are NOT modelled: requests in that tier are under-priced, so supply overrides if you use them. Entries with `validUntil` stop applying after that date.
